headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 17, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 16.71%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 9.69%. This results in an average alpha of 7.02%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' stands out with a remarkable return of 50.99%, contributing a dollar change of $509.94. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has returned 9.58%, which is still above the benchmark but less impressive. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's strength in challenging conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
